evidence.art: Painted title 000-004 and film 005-018 are rich and coherent (moonlit blues against warm torchlight). The walk-shot backdrops 021, 024, 030, 040 hold the same style. The 3D actors in 019-047 are plainly CG and flat against them.
evidence.continuity: Painted Anpu in 016-017 has a full ornate nemes, collar and checkered chest. The 3D Anpu in 019-023 has a plain teal hood and a black body. In 014-018 he is bare-armed and bare-footed, but in 019-047 his limbs read black. Ankhu keeps sandals in 021, 023 and 040, but the 3D face and skin are generic. In 045-047 Ankhu is hidden behind an attendant.
evidence.cinematography: Film shots 005-018 flow well: foetal float to close-up, then memory vignettes, then the arrival wide. Walk cuts at 021, 024, 030, 037 and 040 give varied compositions with a strong foreground statue. 024-025 open on an empty frame for several beats before the group enters. 037-039 is a steep high angle.
evidence.motion_fx: Walk poses vary across 027-029, 038 and 041, and the foot-dust and torch glow are present. Sequences 031-036 show tiny group sprites. 044-045 have Anpu and Ankhu clustered and overlapping, and the end fade 046-048 is abrupt. Poses are stiff and the strides look mannequin-like.
evidence.grounding: Cast shadows exist in 020, 027 and 038. Scale is off in 026-027, where the group is tiny against the statue and pedestal. In 042-045 Anpu and Ankhu clip into the gate shadow and the attendants. Black-limbed Anpu has no readable silhouette against dark ground in 023, and he looks dropped onto the painted plates.
evidence.game_feel: Cuts fire as the group crosses shot boundaries, and the torch line and pylon guide the eye (019-021). In 024-036 the camera dwells on a static view with distant actors, so the player has no direction cue. The 044-045 clump at the gate is unreadable, and the ending has no clear handover.
evidence.ui_title: Title 000-003 has a strong gold serif logo, a clear menu and a highlighted selection. The menu items are small and sit low-left. Subtitles in 023-044 are legible but thin and sit over bright paving, and 036 shows a fading subtitle overlapping the floor.
evidence.audio: Judged from subtitle lines and timing only. Script reads strong: 'I served your house...' (023-025), 'I know. I was there...' (026-027), 'A son. A father...' (029-033), and 'Walk with me, Ankhu...' (042-045). Dialogue is paced, but gaps with no subtitle in 019-022 and 046-048 suggest silence. Anpu's cinematic line 'My Lord... Anpu.' in 016 is the only film subtitle.

defects.what: 3D Anpu is a plain teal hood on a black body, with no ornate nemes, collar or chest, unlike the painted Anpu. Ankhu's 3D model looks generic and different from the painted man.
Characters read as tiny, flat sprites against the painted sets. Anpu is hard to read against the dark ground, and in 042-045 the group clumps together at the gate with Ankhu hidden.
024-025 hold an empty camera frame for many beats. The 046-048 fade is abrupt, and it cuts to a title-like painted frame with no handover to the player.
